## Clearer grid charge window form

The form for time-of-day grid charges now says at each field how to write
the windows: start-end, several separated by commas, for example
`06:00-08:00, 17:15-20:45`. The text above the fields is shorter, and it no
longer ends in "Prefilled from: -" when nothing was prefilled. In Norway,
the chosen grid operator and the date of its tariff still appear there.

Nothing changes in how windows are read, stored or priced.

**Still seeing fields ending in "(hour)" that accept only whole numbers?**
That is the form from before 1.19.0. Install the update in HACS and restart
Home Assistant; reloading the integration is not enough.
